Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 11.00 a.m. 06 July 2026
Valid for the period until 11.00 a.m. 07 July 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via
Mannar and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via
Mannar and, from Matara to Pottuvil
via Hambantota will be very rough at
times with strong gusty winds up to
(55-65) kmph.
The wave height may increase about
(2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off
the coast extending from Chilaw to
Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be vigilant and be
attentive to future forecasts issued by
the Department of Meteorology in
this regard.
